newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks little changed in London.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks little changed in London.

text.p: Japanese stocks were little changed in light trading in London on Monday.
Dealers said the only stock that attracted interest was Nomura Securities Co Ltd, but the shares remained close to their closing level in Tokyo at 1470 yen.
The Nikkei 50 was down 4.32 points to 1,409.08 in London at 1420 GMT.
In Tokyo, the benchmark Nikkei 225 average lost 84.85 pooints to 18,113.89. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
